segments.name: South America Mines
segments.description: Operates the Cerro Verde and El Abra mines in Peru, selling copper concentrate and cathode under annual and multi-year contracts.
segments.evidence: Copper concentrate is also produced at the Cerro Verde mine in Peru and the Grasberg minerals district in Indonesia.

segments.name: Grasberg
segments.description: PT Freeport Indonesia operates the Grasberg minerals district in Indonesia, producing copper concentrate, cathode and gold.
segments.evidence: We produce gold almost exclusively from our mines in the Grasberg minerals district.

segments.name: Molybdenum
segments.description: Produces molybdenum from primary molybdenum mines and as a byproduct, plus conversion facilities in the U.S. and Europe.
segments.evidence: Molybdenum is a key alloying element in steel and the raw material for several chemical-grade products used in catalysts, lubrication, smoke suppression, corrosion inhibition and pigmentation.

segments.name: All other
segments.description: Includes U.S. rod and refining operations, Atlantic Copper smelting and refining in Spain, other mining operations, exploration, legacy oil and gas properties and corporate items.
segments.evidence: Corporate, Other & Eliminations consist of our other mining operations, exploration activities, legacy oil and gas properties, corporate and elimination items.

revenueModel.text: FCX earns revenue from selling copper concentrate, cathode and rod, gold and molybdenum to fabricators, smelters and other customers under dollar- or rupiah-denominated annual and long-term contracts priced off COMEX and LME benchmarks.
revenueModel.evidence: Our consolidated revenues for 2025 primarily included sales of copper (75%), gold (15%) and molybdenum (8%).
